title: Pianists who play too many notes and a night with a rock band
summary: Garland likes piano when played right, and tells how he sat in once with a rock band and could not recognize 'Milenberg Joys'.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

You know, if I get ahead of them guys, they play something I don't know what they're playing than the man in the moon, I follow them.

I went and played with one of them rock bands, once. I won't go play with them. No use for me to go play, I don't know what I'm playing. I played with one one night, the business agent begged me to go, as they had had -- to have a bass player, say, please go, do that favor for me. I say, you know I don't like to play with them guys. I said, this me going to play one key, and it's just running the scale maybe in C or G, that's all they do bab-bab-bab-ab- -- bah. So I got up there on the bandstand and they knocked off, they start to playing -- take one bass, take one bass, take one bass. All right, -bam-babm- that's good, take another one. bab-bab-bab- -- got to playing. I said, what was he playing? You know one thing, I know that number. Man, you're the one, that don't know -- I say no, I mean what's the name of this play -- man that was -- that was -- Milenberg Joys Middleburg Jew. I said, Oh, that's right, I couldn't think of the name of it. I didn't know no more what he was playing than the man in the moon. Milenberg Joys Middleburg Jew. He said, man, you sure taking a hot break in there.
I said, now ain't this awful. I know all I was running the scale like the tenor saxophone was making, bum-bum-bum -- I said bum-bum-bum- --take another one, Tudie. Toetie.
I say, hurry up time come forme to get out of this. I told Spain, I said, man don't you send me out -- beg me to go play at nobody like that.
